focus_notes.closeup_head: Focus must be razor-sharp on the texture of the wrinkled skin and the density of the stiff, light-colored vibrissae. The ivory tusks, including their characteristic striations and wear patterns, should be rendered with high textural fidelity.
focus_notes.default: The anatomy must capture the massive, tapered barrel-shaped trunk and the proportion of the limbs, which are adapted for both swimming and terrestrial movement. focus_notes.closeup_head: Focus must be extremely sharp on the pupils and the distinct texture of the muzzle skin. The zygomatic arches and the heavy, diagnostic submandibular area (hyoid housing) must be clearly defined to distinguish the Alouatta genus.

Anatomical accuracy regarding the proportional length of the limbs to the torso and the placement of the dexterous thumb is paramount.

focus_notes.closeup_head: Render the distinctive pinkish-red, skin-toned facial mask with natural pores and fine, sensory whiskers around the muzzle. The eyes must appear organic with realistic light reflection (catchlight) and anatomical depth, showing the iris texture.
focus_notes.default: Ensure the fur texture displays dense, layered insulation properties, characteristic of a high-altitude primate.
